title: Present the authoritative match-entry cinematic without advancing the game
prompt: Read README.md, AGENTS.md, docs/PILOT100_BACKLOG.md and the exact referenced imported design sections before editing. RULES-SPEC-v1.md is canonical for production mechanics: six-node Repair/Sabotage tracks, one-person crew votes, Route/Gate operations, deterministic powers and silent spectators. SCREEN-FLOW prototype 5/5 scores and hardcoded transitions are UX references only. Preserve historical T01–T10 APIs/tests; implement the new view version in new game-v1 modules instead of silently changing legacy five-mark boards or command parsers. Use black/charcoal/neutral-frost chrome and full-colour approved expressive content through semantic asset keys. Modal-first means the complete game background is uniformly blur/dim/desaturated and inert; the fixed platform banner dock remains mounted outside that game viewport. No visible accounts/login, telemetry, credentials, live Firebase, ad SDK or unreviewed asset downloads. Keep local presentation distinct from authority: clients display server/solo-engine phases and deadlines, never compute secret outcomes, choose timeout targets, advance multiplayer on a local clock or reveal another alignment. Use injected semantic media/ad/purchase ports; no direct SDK playback or billing calls from UI. Edit only ownership, use original fixtures, run scoped tests/lint/typecheck and npm run check. DOM tests use jsdom, explicit afterEach(cleanup), Vitest and current Testing Library. Report results and contract changes; do not commit, push, open PRs, deploy or spend on providers. Implement the required brief two-second transition between Solo setup/filled lobby and private Role Reveal: fade the previous scene, show City signal acquired / Entering the blackout with a restrained signal loader, and emit semantic crossfade/stinger requests. Keep the banner dock mounted and stable. Presentation waits for the appropriate local-engine or server start acknowledgment and cannot create match authority; an animation completing before acknowledgment remains waiting. Reduced Motion preserves the clear mode boundary without flashing/shake. Dispose stale transitions on navigation.
acceptance: The player sees an unmistakable setup-to-gameplay handoff and enters reveal only after start acknowledgment.
Transition semantics request the specified music-bed crossfade/stinger through the injected port exactly once.
Persistent dock and safe viewport do not blink, remount or reflow during scene fades.
Reduced Motion, slow/failed acknowledgment, cancellation and repeated start signals are tested with controlled clocks.
